what_does_it_do: Allows an IS-04 Sender to express parametric constraints on the types of streams that it is capable of producing
why_does_it_matter: Controllers need to know whether a Receiver is capable of handling the streams a Sender is capable of producing before connecting the two
Controllers need to know whether a Sender is capable of handling specific stream parameters before applying IS-11 active constraints
how_does_it_work: Establishes an open Capabilities register in the NMOS Parameter Registers that lists specifications for parametric constraints (such as width, height, frame rate, number of channels, etc.)
Defines how a Sender instantiates these Parameter Constraints to make up a list of acceptable Constraint Sets, within the IS-04 `caps` attribute
